title: 开挖作业
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/143_开挖作业.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/143_开挖作业/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在施工围挡外
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a safety helmet and stands outside a construction fence on a campus road, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第六课：开挖作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向围挡后的沟槽
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a trench behind the fence and raises one finger in warning.
shots.narration: 沟槽一塌，几秒钟就能埋住人。

shots.scene: 实验楼旁正在挖管沟，沟壁直立
shots.prompt_en: Beside a laboratory building, a narrow pipeline trench has been dug with straight vertical walls and no supports.
shots.narration: 实验楼旁，正在挖一条管沟。

shots.scene: 沟边堆满挖出的土，小挖掘机停在沟边
shots.prompt_en: Dug soil is piled right at the trench edge and a small excavator is parked next to it.
shots.narration: 沟壁直上直下，土堆在沟边。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps toward the trench edge, trying to take a shortcut across it.
shots.narration: 阿杰想跨过去抄近路。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the young male student with a raised hand, pointing at the crumbling trench edge.
shots.narration: 老李：站住！沟边随时会塌。

shots.scene: 地面上挖出的坑、槽、沟示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pit, a long trench and a cut in the ground shown side by side in cross section. No text.
shots.narration: 从地面挖走土方，形成坑、槽、沟。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrow trench cross section with a depth arrow longer than the width arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 又窄又深、深比宽大，叫沟槽。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a worker with a shovel and a small excavator digging. No text.
shots.narration: 开挖分人工开挖和机械开挖。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: timber and steel struts pushing against both walls of a trench. No text.
shots.narration: 撑住沟壁、防塌方的结构，叫支撑。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: soil sliding down from a trench wall into the trench bottom, arrows showing the collapse. No text.
shots.narration: 沟壁土石脱落、坍下来，就是塌方。

shots.scene: 塌方埋住沟里的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person icon in a trench covered up to the chest by collapsed soil, a red warning. No text.
shots.narration: 塌方最常见，几秒钟就能埋住人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heavy soil weight arrows pressing on a chest and a breathing icon blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 被埋压后，重压和窒息都能致命。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank rescue plan beside a rescue tripod and shovels near a trench. No text.
shots.narration: 开工前就要备好救援预案。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons around a trench, a broken buried cable, a falling person, collapsing soil and a gas cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 开挖四类危害，一个都不能漏。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shovel striking a buried cable with sparks and a water pipe spraying water. No text.
shots.narration: 挖断电缆、水管、燃气管，后果严重。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person, a cart and a brick falling into an open trench, arrows down. No text.
shots.narration: 人、车、物，都可能掉进沟里。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water collecting at the bottom of a trench, the walls getting wet. No text.
shots.narration: 坑里积水，泡软沟壁。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shallow trench with a small collapse onto a kneeling worker's legs, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 沟浅也会塌，蹲着干活照样被埋。

shots.scene: 围挡、警示、查管线三个勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three ticks, a barrier, a warning sign and a pipeline drawing, next to a shallow trench. No text.
shots.narration: 围挡、警示、查管线，一样不少。

shots.scene: 国外数字打叉，规范和方案打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foreign ruler crossed out and a national standard book with a construction plan ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 要不要支护，按规范和方案定。

shots.scene: 老李对照地下管线图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer spreads out an underground utility drawing on a table and traces lines with a finger.
shots.narration: 动土之前，先查清地下管线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: arrows from a work team to the campus facilities office and the construction office, a drawing coming back. No text.
shots.narration: 找后勤、基建部门调管线图纸。

shots.scene: 地面用旗子标出管线走向
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small marker flags along the ground showing the path of a buried cable. No text.
shots.narration: 现场探测，标出管线位置。

shots.scene: 管线附近改用人工小心挖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: near the marked cable, the excavator stops and a worker digs gently by hand. No text.
shots.narration: 靠近管线，改用人工小心挖。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank excavation permit form receiving a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 动土作业，先办审批。

shots.scene: 深基坑方案由专业工程师审核
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a structural engineer reviewing a blank deep pit support plan with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 深基坑支护，要有专项方案并审批。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supervisor briefing a small group of workers beside a trench before starting work. No text.
shots.narration: 开工先培训，班前交底再干活。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three soil cross sections, loose sand, mixed soil and firm clay, the loose one crumbling. No text.
shots.narration: 土越松越容易塌，支护也不一样。

shots.scene: 专业人员目测并用手测试土样
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a qualified inspector looking at a trench wall and testing a soil sample in his hand. No text.
shots.narration: 土质要看也要测，由专业人员判定。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank geological survey report beside a blank construction plan. No text.
shots.narration: 按勘察结论和方案确定放坡支护。

shots.scene: 放坡、台阶、支撑、板桩四种示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four trench cross sections, sloped walls, stepped benches, braced walls and sheet piles. No text.
shots.narration: 护沟壁：放坡、台阶、支撑、板桩。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trench with both walls cut back into a gentle slope, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 放坡：把沟壁挖成斜坡，不让它塌。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a steel trench box placed inside a trench, a worker safely inside it. No text.
shots.narration: 支护箱撑住沟壁，保护沟里的人。

shots.scene: 建筑基础下开挖先支撑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shoring placed under the foundation of a building before digging beneath it. No text.
shots.narration: 挖到楼房基础下，先支撑再挖。

shots.scene: 坡度按方案，不照搬数字
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slope angle icon beside a blank construction plan, a foreign number crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 坡度和支护，按土质、深度和方案定。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trench edge with a soil pile, a parked truck and vibration waves, cracks forming in the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 坑边堆物、车辆、振动，都会引塌方。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the soil pile and the truck moved back from the trench edge with a safe gap. No text.
shots.narration: 堆土、材料和车辆，远离坑边。

shots.scene: 挖掘机回转范围拉警戒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an excavator with its swing radius marked by a barrier circle, a person kept outside. No text.
shots.narration: 挖掘机转臂范围内，不能进。

shots.scene: 先让司机知道，机器停稳再进
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker signaling to an excavator driver, the machine stopped with its bucket on the ground. No text.
shots.narration: 非进不可，告诉司机，停稳再进。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a qualified inspector with a checklist walking along a trench each morning. No text.
shots.narration: 开挖现场，懂行的专人每天检查。

shots.scene: 检查裂缝、积水、堆土、管线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: magnifier icons on a crack at the trench edge, water at the bottom, a soil pile and a pipe. No text.
shots.narration: 看裂缝、积水、堆土和管线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rain over a trench, then a pump removing water and an inspector checking the walls. No text.
shots.narration: 下雨、振动后，先排水、再复查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker waiting at the trench edge until the inspector gives a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 确认安全，才能再下沟。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fixed ladder inside a trench reaching up to ground level. No text.
shots.narration: 沟里要有梯子等上下通道。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top of the ladder extending above the trench edge, a hand gripping it. No text.
shots.narration: 梯子伸出地面一截，上下有扶手。

shots.scene: 长沟隔一段设一个出口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long trench with several ladders placed along it, arrows showing escape to the nearest one. No text.
shots.narration: 长沟按规范间隔设出口，就近撤离。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker climbing out of a trench on the struts, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不踩支撑爬上爬下。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a deep pit next to an old sewer pipe and a chemical store, a gas cloud gathering at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 低洼深坑，可能积聚有害气体。

shots.scene: 下坑前用便携式检测仪检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker lowering a portable gas detector into a pit before anyone enters. No text.
shots.narration: 人下去之前，先测氧含量和有害气体。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a deep pit with a confined space warning sign and an attendant standing at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 深坑按受限空间管理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trench with one worker inside and others waiting outside the barrier. No text.
shots.narration: 不需要的人，不下沟。

shots.scene: 安全帽、安全鞋、反光背心
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker wearing a safety helmet, safety boots and a reflective vest, slippers crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 安全帽、安全鞋，不穿拖鞋。

shots.scene: 长柄工具，屈膝挺背，轮换休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker using a long handle shovel with bent knees and a straight back, a rest clock nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 手工挖土，屈膝挺背，轮换休息。

shots.scene: 开挖区硬质围挡和夜间警示灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trench surrounded by solid barriers with warning signs and flashing lights at night. No text.
shots.narration: 围挡、警示灯，白天黑夜都要有。

shots.scene: 有车经过处用硬围挡，警示带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: at a road crossing, a plastic warning tape is crossed out and solid barriers are ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 有车有人经过，用硬质围挡。

shots.scene: 【实拍】学生沿施工围挡外的人行通道绕行（全景）
shots.prompt_en: Wide shot: a student walks along a marked pedestrian path outside a construction fence, following the detour sign.
shots.narration: 学生按指示绕行，不翻越围挡。

shots.scene: 学生不下沟，发现问题报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student at a fence calling the campus facilities office about a missing barrier. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不进沟槽，发现缺口立即报告。

shots.scene: 停水停电通知贴在实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank utility shutdown notice posted on the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 管线施工，可能停水停电停气。

shots.scene: 小研提前关好设备、转移样品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shuts down an instrument and moves samples into a backup freezer before the shutdown.
shots.narration: 收到通知，提前停实验、保护样品。

shots.scene: 野外采样坑做好标记和回填
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small field sampling pit marked with flags and a barrier, then filled back in. No text.
shots.narration: 野外采样挖坑，也要围挡和回填。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a broken cable, a falling person, collapsing soil and a gas cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 开挖防塌方、防管线、防坠落、防毒气。

shots.scene: 查管线、放坡支护、每天检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a pipeline drawing, a sloped trench and an inspector with a checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 先查管线，放坡支护，每天检查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fenced trench and a student walking around it on a path. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不下沟，按指示绕行。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一把挂锁和一张吊牌挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a padlock and a blank danger tag and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：危险能量控制，上锁挂牌。
